mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_history ( user_id, user_nm, client_ip, action, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{clientIp}, #{action}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE created_at = NOW();
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip) FROM tb_user_history WHERE action = '로그인' AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DATE(created_at), client_ip FROM tb_user_history WHERE action = '로그인' AND YEARWEEK(created_at, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) ) AS daily_unique
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT DATE(created_at), client_ip FROM tb_user_history WHERE action = '로그인' AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m') ) AS daily_unique
